fusions.name: Toothed Vise
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Shuts a toothed vise on it, which deals 24 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Death-Roll Flywheel
fusions.desc: A flywheel spins you through a full roll, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Waiting Jaws
fusions.desc: Sets a sprung iron trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 50 seconds, and deals 16 damage in a blast around it to each of the first 2 enemies to come within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Coiled Mainspring
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
